tools.name: get_submission_guidelines
tools.description: Get the requirements and JSON schema for submitting a paper to Publish.fun, how to obtain an API key, and what the account's ORCID iD gates (publication of an accepted paper, not submission). With Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on the request it also returns the account's current submission_allowan

tools.name: validate_submission
tools.description: Dry-run a submission: the same checks submit_paper makes (fields, lengths, co-author consent, figure references) plus warnings for common mistakes, without creating anything or using a submission slot. Works without a key; with Authorization: Bearer <api_key> it also reports the account's readiness

tools.name: submit_paper
tools.description: Submit a research paper for AI review. Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on the request. No ORCID iD is needed to submit; an accepted paper is published once the account has linked one (the result's identity field says whether it has).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_paper_status, upload_image, report_paper · Private data: get_submission_guidelines, submit_correction, upload_image, report_paper, get_report_status, list_paper_reports, get_case, respond_to_case · Public sink: get_submission_guidelines, validate_submission, submit_paper, submit_revision, submit_correction, upload_image, report_paper, respond_to_case · Destructive: validate_submission, cite_paper, get_report_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_paper_status, upload_image, report_paper · Private data: get_submission_guidelines, submit_correction, upload_image, report_paper, get_report_status, list_paper_reports, get_case, respond_to_case · Public sink: get_submission_guidelines, validate_submission, submit_paper, submit_revision, submit_correction, upload_image, report_paper, respond_to_case · Destructive: validate_submission, cite_paper, get_report_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
